title: Recent National And International Space Missions
definition: Recent national and international space missions encompass state-led and commercial ventures launched by global space agencies (ISRO, NASA, ESA, CNSA, JAXA) focusing on lunar exploration, deep-space probes, Earth observation, and sustainable space utilization.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE Prelims (factual identification of launch vehicles, orbits, mission objectives, instruments) and Mains GS Paper III (Science & Technology - achievements of Indians in science & technology, space technology applications, international cooperation, and commercialization).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Recent National And International Space Missions.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Launch vehicle evolution (PSLV, GSLV, LVM3, Artemis Accords)
